scripts._comment_scope: Web-only plan. apps/mobile is intentionally excluded from CI and the composite test/build scripts. It remains in workspaces so npm ci links @playmatch/shared for local mobile dev. Run 'npm --prefix apps/mobile test' manually to test mobile.
scripts.lint: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:server
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:web && npm run test:server
scripts.build:shared: npm --prefix packages/shared run build 2>nul || echo packages/shared has no build step
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
